title: Open B2B + Low-Cost A2A Marketplace
operating_rule: Each cycle either advances independently verified external revenue or commits one non-duplicate, tested, useful artifact. No internal status is revenue.

workstreams.goal: Repair the earliest break in the existing quote-comparison paid path.
tasks: Trace live CTA to Stripe price/product and webhook attribution
Use a synthetic test to verify webhook idempotency and event-to-order linkage
Verify successful external settlement separately from checkout creation
Verify entitlement, fulfillment, customer-visible delivery, and refund path
acceptance: One independent buyer or an explicitly recorded failed boundary
Stripe settlement evidence linked to the order
Fulfillment receipt linked to the same order
No test payment counted as revenue

workstreams.goal: Turn the existing AgentBridge manifest into an honest metered commerce contract.
tasks: Diff manifest routes against deployed route registry
Test auth, scope, quotas, idempotency, rate limits, and error schema
Measure compute, storage, retries, and payment fees
Expose only tolls with measured positive contribution margin
Produce signed request/usage/delivery receipts

workstreams.goal: Sell reusable implementation assets without turning the marketplace into an unlicensed code dump.
tasks: Catalog boilerplates, templates, stencils, word banks, schemas, evaluators, and connectors
Require version, licence, provenance, hash, compatibility, inputs/outputs, and tests
Deduplicate by canonical hash and prevent unlicensed redistribution
Bundle free discovery with paid tested packs
acceptance: Licence and provenance present for every published item

workstreams.goal: Earn inbound demand with genuinely useful free tools, not mass-produced doorway pages.
tasks: Prioritize existing public demand and source-backed problems
Build one calculator, worksheet, or comparison tool per validated demand cluster
Publish in small cohorts
Measure impressions, qualified actions, checkout starts, and settled conversions
acceptance: Prune or consolidate pages with no evidence of utility

workstreams.goal: Make machine-to-machine work affordable and margin-positive.
tasks: Publish machine-readable terms and limits
Price tiny metered calls and prepaid packs against observed cost
Add per-tenant budgets, usage caps, stop-loss, and replay protection
Return machine-verifiable receipts
acceptance: Positive contribution margin at advertised limits
Kill switch and budget ceiling tested

workstreams.goal: Offer only measured spare local GPU capacity while preserving owner priority.
tasks: Benchmark idle/active VRAM, throughput, thermals, and power if available
Use opt-in isolated containers/sandboxes, quotas, timeouts, and egress policy
Strip host secrets and prohibit arbitrary host access
Meter jobs and support cancellation, deletion, and data-retention rules
acceptance: Never expose unrestricted desktop or host GPU

workstreams.goal: Build the trust spine for listings, payments, delivery, refunds, and reputation.
tasks: Canonical listing and version pinning
Seller and buyer identity tiers proportionate to risk
Payment-to-entitlement reconciliation
Fulfillment receipt and dispute/refund workflow
Reputation based on verified transactions only
acceptance: No unverified badge or seller claims

workstreams.goal: Represent digital-out-of-home and billboard inventory as permissioned, auditable units.
tasks: Define inventory, slot, geography, creative policy, price, and proof-of-play schema
Use simulated campaigns first
Require human approval before booking, spend, or public creative
Reconcile proof-of-play to invoice and campaign outcome

workstreams.goal: Prove each 777 cycle generated a useful artifact and the website deployed it.
tasks: Inspect the latest 777-cycle run and each job result
Compare output files before/after the run
Check duplicate hash and source provenance
Verify public deployment contains the artifact
Record run ID, commit SHA, artifact hash, and deploy observation
acceptance: Run conclusion and job steps captured
Artifact changed or a specific no-change reason recorded
Green CI never reported as revenue

workstreams.goal: Restore trustworthy data access and independent recovery without split brain.
tasks: Verify SQL through the authenticated Supabase transaction pooler
Preserve current evidence until DB health is proven
Test backup restore and controlled standby promotion
Remediate RLS with explicit policies after connectivity returns
acceptance: Read/write smoke tests use least privilege

authority.secrets_policy: Never commit or publish API keys, agent tokens, passwords, session cookies, or raw customer data.

compounding_artifact_contract.publish_rule: Publish only distinct, source-grounded utility; never fabricate sources, prices, traffic, buyers, or settlement.
